subject.title: fix(exec): prevent revoked policy from authorizing delayed node runs

question: Should this cross-runtime authorization contract be made self-contained in this PR, or may it land only as an explicitly atomic stack with its missing macOS consumers?
rationale: Two privileged native paths still do not receive the approval-time snapshot, and accepting any temporary partial security boundary is a maintainer-owned landing and release decision.

options.title: Make this PR self-contained
options.body: Add both Swift wire fields and enforce the forwarded snapshot in the HMAC and direct Mac node final commits before merge.

options.title: Authorize an atomic stack
options.body: Review the dependent consumer work first and land all commits in a controlled sequence that cannot be used or released partially.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Keep this PR open without landing until the full native consumer boundary is ready and proven.

recommendation.title: Make this PR self-contained
recommendation.body: Add both Swift wire fields and enforce the forwarded snapshot in the HMAC and direct Mac node final commits before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the recent merged and proposed cross-runtime execution-policy work and is the strongest available owner for the landing-boundary choice.
